steps.title: About you
steps.intro: Who should we talk to? We save your answers after every step, so you can stop and pick up where you left off.

fields.label: Work e-mail
fields.error: Use an e-mail address like name@organisation.eu.

fields.label: Phone
fields.error: Use digits, spaces and a leading + only.

fields.label: Country
fields.help: Rudi runs in the EU only.

fields.label: I agree to be contacted by the Rudi team if any crucial input is missing before my Rudi clone goes live.
fields.error: Please tick this, so we can get back to you about your request.

steps.title: Your programme
steps.intro: Who you support, and what should happen between appointments.

fields.label: What kind of organisation are you?
Website
fields.help: So we can read up before we talk.
fields.error: Use a full address, starting with https://

fields.label: What should Rudi help people do?
fields.help: The plan they get from you, and what tends to slip between appointments. No details about real patients or participants.
fields.placeholder: e.g. Keep moving after cardiac rehab: short walks, the weekly class, and noticing when energy dips.
fields.error: A sentence or two is enough (at least 20 characters).

fields.label: Who will talk to Rudi?
fields.placeholder: e.g. adults who finished our 12-week programme
fields.error: Tell us who Rudi is for.

fields.label: How many people in a first pilot?
When would you like to start?

steps.title: Where people reach Rudi
steps.intro: Choose one or more. You can add channels later.

options.label: WhatsApp
options.hint: Check-ins in the app people already use.

options.label: Phone calls
options.hint: A short spoken check-in at a time that suits them.

options.label: Chat on your website
options.hint: A Rudi window on your own pages.

options.label: Your own app
options.hint: Through our API, inside your product.

options.label: A Rudi number
options.hint: Ready the soonest.

options.label: Our WhatsApp Business account
options.hint: Your name in the chat; takes longer to set up.

fields.label: When may Rudi call?
fields.help: Rudi never calls at night, whatever you choose here.
fields.error: The end time must be later than the start time.

fields.label: We send API documentation and a test key once the pilot is agreed.

steps.title: What Rudi does
steps.intro: Pick what your Rudi should be good at. Each one is a tested skill.

options.label: Set goals together
options.hint: Turns your plan into small, personal goals.

options.label: Check in between appointments
options.hint: Asks how it went and helps pick things up again.

options.label: Turn intentions into commitments
options.hint: Agrees a concrete next step and a time for it.

options.label: Keep his promises
options.hint: Comes back exactly when he said he would.

options.label: Speak each person’s language
options.hint: Answers in the language they write or speak.

options.label: Explain what Rudi is, and isn’t
options.hint: Honest about being an AI, and about his limits.

fields.label: Something Rudi can’t do yet?
fields.help: Tell us. Our team reviews every request; a new ability is built and checked by people before any Rudi uses it.
fields.placeholder: e.g. Remind people of their training schedule from our weekly plan.

steps.title: Rudi’s personality
steps.intro: How your Rudi sounds. You can fine-tune this together with us later.

fields.label: How often should Rudi check in?

options.label: Two or three times a week

steps.title: Staying in control
steps.intro: Your team gets a cockpit: one place to follow your Rudi, step in and change course. How closely do you want to be involved?

fields.label: How involved should your team be?

options.label: Rudi runs, we keep an eye
options.hint: Summaries and alerts. We look in when something needs us.

options.label: We follow along and step in
options.hint: We read conversations when we want and can take over a chat.

options.label: We approve before Rudi sends
options.hint: A person on our team checks some messages first.

fields.label: Which messages need approval first?
fields.help: Approval slows replies down: people wait until someone on your team is available.

options.label: The first message to each person

fields.label: What should your team be able to do?
fields.help: Choose all you might need. We switch on only what your pilot uses.

options.label: Read conversations
options.hint: With a clear notice to your people that your team can see the chat.

options.label: Take over a conversation
options.hint: Write to someone yourself; Rudi waits until you hand back.

options.label: Correct or overrule Rudi
options.hint: Flag a reply, send a correction and teach Rudi for next time.

options.label: Pause Rudi for one person
options.hint: For a holiday, a hospital stay or on request.

options.label: Send a message through Rudi
options.hint: To one person or a group, in their Rudi chat.

options.label: Change settings yourself
options.hint: Tone, check-in rhythm and quiet hours.

fields.label: When can someone on your team step in?

options.label: Extended hours
options.hint: Including some evenings or weekends.

options.label: Unfortunately, we have no capacity to stand by
options.hint: Rudi keeps alerts for when someone is back.

fields.label: When should Rudi alert your team?
fields.help: When health or safety is at stake, Rudi always points people to their clinician or emergency services, and tells you.

options.label: A safety concern
options.hint: Always on.

options.label: Someone asks a medical question
options.hint: Rudi doesn’t answer it; he points them back to you.

options.label: Someone has gone quiet
options.hint: No reply for a while.

steps.title: What you see
steps.intro: What would show you that your Rudi works, and for whom?

fields.label: What should the cockpit show?
fields.help: Numbers are counted across people. Themes never show one person’s words.

options.label: Who is active
options.hint: People reached, replies and drop-off.

options.label: Check-ins
options.hint: Sent, answered and followed up.

options.label: Goals and follow-through
options.hint: Goals set and kept, week by week.

options.label: Who needs attention
options.hint: People who went quiet or slipped.

options.label: What people talk about
options.hint: Themes across all conversations.

options.label: How people rate Rudi
options.hint: Short feedback after check-ins.

options.label: Safety events
options.hint: Alerts and how they were handled.

options.label: Usage and costs
options.hint: Conversations, minutes and spend.

fields.label: How do you want the numbers?

options.label: Exports for our own tools
options.hint: CSV or API.

fields.label: How many people on your team will use the cockpit?

options.label: Programme lead
options.hint: Settings and reports.

options.label: Coaches or care staff
options.hint: Follow people and step in.

options.label: Data or quality team
options.hint: Reports and exports.

options.label: IT
options.hint: Connections and access.

fields.label: Anything else you’d want to see or control?

steps.title: Set-up, and send
steps.intro: Nearly there. A few last details, then your request is on its way.

fields.label: Do you have material Rudi should learn from?
fields.help: Programme descriptions, schedules, plans or guidelines. We send you a secure upload link after this request. Leave out personal data about patients or participants.

fields.label: Bringing your own AI or tools?
fields.help: By default Rudi supplies and runs everything: the AI models, their use and the hosting in the EU. There is nothing to arrange on your side. If you already have something you’d like to use, tell us here.

options.label: Rudi supplies it
options.hint: Included. Nothing to arrange.

options.label: We’d like to use our own subscription
options.hint: Our own account or key with an AI provider.

fields.label: Is it hosted in the EU, under a data processing agreement?
fields.help: Rudi only uses AI services that keep data in the EU. We check yours with you.

fields.label: Anything else Rudi should work with?

options.label: Our WhatsApp Business or Twilio account

fields.label: Should Rudi trust your own sign-in for your app or website?
fields.help: Then people talk to Rudi without signing in twice.

fields.label: Tell us more
fields.placeholder: e.g. We have an Azure OpenAI contract in West Europe and use Microsoft Teams.

fields.label: We will sign a data processing agreement with Rudi. All data stays in the EU.
fields.error: Please confirm to send your request.

fields.label: We understand Rudi supports follow-through. He doesn’t diagnose, prescribe or replace professional care.
